summary: Shows the unsafe option on vars_prompt to accept special characters like { and % without templating errors.
questions: Why does my prompted password with % or { cause a templating error?
How do I allow special characters in vars_prompt?

answer_card.title: Special characters in vars_prompt
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
vars_prompt:
  - name: my_password_with_weird_chars
    prompt: Enter password
    unsafe: true
    private: true
```

`unsafe: true` stops `{` and `%` from being treated as templates.
